name: vital-trusted
description: Nineteen skills that help people across a life-sciences company use an AI assistant for daily work with peace of mind, against seven needs: Tangible, Rule-compliant, Unbiased, Safe, True, Ethical, Defensible. Supports, never replaces, the company's own SOPs and review. Offline-first: Prove skills run without a key and label results not tool-checked; optional TRUSTED Prove live MCP (same endpoint mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/verify, server id trusted-prove) adds live source admission when a vvfy_ key is present. The vital-verify plugin is retired — this pack is the sole buyer surface. Human oversight required for healthcare use.

verify_key.title: VITAL Verify key
verify_key.description: Personal vvfy_ key for TRUSTED Prove live tools (mcp.vital.expert). Optional: without it, Prove skills still run offline and label results not tool-checked. Do not install a separate vital-verify plugin.
